headline: FTC Sues Dollar General Over Deceptive Pricing Practices
summary: The Federal Trade Commission filed a lawsuit against Dollar General amid growing consumer skepticism regarding retail pricing fairness.
why: Dollar General is a major discount retailer operating thousands of stores across the United States, making regulatory compliance critical for consumer discretionary firms.

impacts.name: Dollar General
impacts.why: A federal lawsuit regarding pricing practices can damage brand reputation and lead to potential legal penalties or compliance overhead.

why_moved: An FTC enforcement action introduces direct legal risk and potential financial liabilities for the retailer.
